_readme: Define one entry per voice character, then build with:
Validate the file first (fast, no generation):
Generation is stochastic: build_cast.py generates --tries candidates (3 by
default) and keeps the one closest to the reference in pitch and timbre.
templates/characters.json holds the real, built 9-character cast — this file
is the annotated schema plus a worked example.

_schema.key: required · short id, used for filenames and --voice
_schema.name: required · the character's name, shown in the gallery
_schema.lang: required · 'ta' or 'en' (must have an AUDITION line in core.py). This is the character's native accent, NOT a limit — every voice can speak Tamil, Tanglish and English; narrate.py detects the language from the text
_schema.gender: required · 'male' or 'female' — sets the F0 range it is checked against
_schema.persona: optional but recommended · one line on how the voice should be directed
_schema.source_voice: required unless ref_audio · a free Edge voice, see scripts/list_voices.py
_schema.pitch: optional · shifts the reference before cloning, e.g. '-14Hz'. Small shifts read as a different person; large ones (beyond roughly ±25Hz) start to sound pitch-shifted. Use it to separate two Edge-sourced characters that landed on the same F0 — Valluvar (+28Hz) and Pallavi (-40Hz) both needed it
_schema.rate: optional · e.g. '-8%'. Slower reads as more authoritative, faster as more energetic
_schema.ref_audio: optional · clone your own recording instead of an Edge voice. Requires ref_text. Only use audio you have the right to clone — see reference/consent.md
_schema.ref_text: required with ref_audio · the EXACT transcript of the clip. A wrong one degrades the clone. Verify the whole cast with scripts/check_refs.py
_schema.ref_trim: optional · [start, end] in seconds, to cut the reference down to its usable span — dropping a code-mixed English phrase, a cough or a second speaker. ref_text must cover ONLY the kept window. Trim for alignment, not clarity: it reliably fixes ref_text match, F0 drift and noise floor, but does not measurably improve pronunciation
_schema.denoise: optional · default true. Set false only if the reference is already clean and you want it untouched
_schema.instruct: optional · free-text style direction. Measured as HARMFUL on this checkpoint, which is not instruction-tuned — it degraded every variant and collapsed to 0% intelligibility with no reference. Plumbed through for a future checkpoint; do not use it to fix prosody

characters.persona: warm documentary narrator, unhurried and certain

characters.ref_text: Exactly and only what is said between 0.0s and 8.5s of that clip.
